notes: Expanded set of notable London pubs, including a Hackney section. All coordinates were checked against Google Maps listings in October 2026. Clues based on pub legends are worded as 'said to' or 'claimed'. Ye Olde Swiss Cottage closed in February 2025; its building still stands.
